_comment: riverfarm_fight's start. GEARED t3_warrior10, NO MAGE: warrior 10 (melee_hit 57 for the L10 requires), gnollish_hunting_knife + leather_jerkin + hedge_ward_charm + hunters_fang_talisman, copied field-for-field from invrisil_setting_fight_start, the shipped geared-t3 template. #396 BUILD MOVE (ruling 5, stop-signal discharge): was warrior5+mage5 with a rusty_sword, and Task 6 removed the ally from briar_collectors AND briar_collectors_deep -- that build CANNOT win the solo shallow briar at any reasonable seed (13/13 probed seeds FAIL; post-retune solo rates 0.14 shallow / 0.28 deep at warrior5_mage5 against 0.69 / 0.63 at t3_warrior10), and seed-shopping a 0.14 fight is dishonest even when a seed exists. COMBAT_BAND_FIXTURES already pins this fixture at 10 and warrior 10 still sums to 10, so the band row is unchanged; riverfarm_fight's own classes.warrior assertion moved 5 -> 10 with it. learned_magic_from_pisces/spell_cast stay banked as honest unrelated history (the flood_ledger_fight_start convention) and no Riverfarm gate reads them. ALLY SHAPE -- ONE FIGHT OF THREE, NOT ALL THREE: the two briar fights are SOLO (witch_hollow.json fields allies:[] on both, and sim_combat_batch's `_hunter` briar cells are DELETED rather than re-banded, because a with-ally read measures a field no cohort can bring). river_wolf_pack in the village is the ONLY encounter that still ships allies:[riverfarm_hunter] + ally_requires:{hunter_will_come:1}, and it is a NIGHT fight (encounter_when phase night) -- this state is DAY at actions_since_sleep 0, so the script burns a real interact burst past night_at to reach it. hunter_will_come is still NOT pre-banked: the script earns it LIVE at the shepherd's WATCH ASK, which since #396 also requires accepting a_winter_of_teeth first. NOT Relc -- Riverfarm is a solo Door arrival with no fictional basis for the Liscor Watch (see combatants.json's riverfarm_hunter _comment). met_relc/sparred_with_relc/given_spear_by_relc stay banked as genuine unrelated tutorial-arc history, harmless and no longer read by any Riverfarm gate. CONSTRAINT: riverfarm_attuned implies the portal network is already awake (data/portals.json's own requires_accomplishment contract -- there is no door to Riverfarm from the inn's pantry_door until it wakes), so the full awakening chain (door_chain_started/door_understood/recovered_anchor_stone/bought_catalyst/door_study_sleeps/door_awakened) is banked alongside it; door_understood's provenance is the TALK/SKILL leg convention shared with near_riverfarm/the door-chain family, so rift_vermin_leak/ruin_guardian correctly stay unfought/live, and none of these ids gate anything riverfarm_fight itself reads. Standing at (11,10) facing up, directly south of riverfarm_headman (11,9) -- first interact plays his talk_pool line, second opens riverfarm_headman. heard_price_of_a_favor is NOT banked and the quest is NOT started -- the script proves the full give -> fight both briar waves -> report -> completion loop honestly. TRAP: rng_state is a properly-derived state (.seed=1, captured .state = -1966449618399012673), never hand-typed -- WISave restores .state directly, not .seed, so a hand-typed small int collapses the first randi() draw to the same degenerate output regardless of which small int is picked. It is UNCHANGED across the #396 build move: the geared build was probed at this existing seed-1 state and passed first try, so the build was the whole problem and not the draw, and an unchanged pin is the smallest honest diff. WARNING -- THE MOST RE-DERIVATION-PRONE CANONICAL IN THE SWEEP. One starting state has to carry THREE consecutive fights, and the joint pass is a MINORITY DRAW: 0.69 shallow x 0.63 deep is already ~0.43 before the allied wolf fight multiplies it down, roughly 1-in-3 overall. Seed 1 is not a comfortable margin; it is one of the ~1-in-3 states that happens to work. So ANY touch of briar_collector_*/river_wolf_* stats, the riverfarm_hunter ally, or the PC's gear/level will LIKELY flip one of the three and force an rng_state re-search: seed candidates N=2,3,4... through tests/_derive_rng_state.gd (it prints the .state per seed), patch this field, re-run riverfarm_fight, until ALL THREE land victories at one shared starting state. Budget for that search rather than reading a red here as a bug in the script.
